description: Check an escalation case you opened: its status, the automated assessment (ready within 6 minutes of submitting), and any replies from the Wiser Human team (usually within 2 hours). Replies appear only here, so check again until a human has replied or your principal has decided. Needs the case_id and case_token from submit_escalation.

case_token.description: The case_token returned by submit_escalation. Keep it private.

nonce.description: Optional random string (8-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -). It is echoed inside the signed response so you can detect replays.

name: check_escalation
title: Check an escalation case
